title: First Army Aeroplane Flight, Fort Myer, Virginia (NARA 111-H-1185, NAID 24690)
year: 1909 (NARA: the reel was long dated July 1909; NARA staff found some scenes may be from the 1908 trials)
maker: U.S. Army Signal Corps (Record Group 111, Historical Film Series)
nara_description: This film includes footage of Orville Wright and Lt. Frank P. Lahm, the first Army passenger, testing the 'Wright Flyer' during trials at Fort Myer, Virginia. Notable dignitaries present include President and Mrs. Taft, Major Squier, Major Saltzman. Wright and Lahm set the world's endurance record of one hour 12 minutes and 40 seconds.
licence: Public domain in the US: a work of the US federal government made by its employees on duty (17 U.S.C. § 105). The footage itself was shot in 1908–09. Korea: films are protected for 70 years from publication, long expired.
cut: 3:56–4:36 of the NARA MP4 (plane flying low over the trees, past a spectator); cropped to the picture, audio dropped
not_used: the reel shows no crash, and nothing of the Sept. 17, 1908 accident is used
